description: Use this when a seller asks which print-on-demand (POD) supplier costs less for a product, wants a Printify vs Printful comparison, or needs product prices, shipping, delivered totals or delivery times. Compares Printify, Printful, Gelato, Prodigi, Apliiq, Artelo, CustomCat, Fourthwall, Inkthreadable and merchOne for one product and configuration, destination and currency. Search products first; for a specific size or color pass choices or an optionKey from get_product_options, otherwise it uses the product's usual configuration and returns its label. Totals and rankings are product + shipping; unknown costs stay null; similar products stay separate; affiliate links never change rankings. pricingTier base is standard pricing; use paid plans only when asked. supplier lists one supplier's every product and print provider for the choice. Seller context, only when the seller already said it: yourSupplier pins their current supplier first with the difference per sale; sellingPrice or targetMargin with salesChannel and shopLocation applies approved platform fees. When the seller mentions any of these, call again with them instead of estimating profit yourself; if salesChannel or shopLocation is missing, the result lists what to ask. Profit is an estimate before tax. Supplier-billed duty is separate: established, zero, a bounded estimate or unverified. Profit deducts established duty or a converted estimate; unverified duty or an unconverted native estimate leaves profit before that charge. Show one estimated duty amount (the converted upper endpoint, or the native one marked not converted), never a min–max range. Estimated or unverified duty and conditional design/setup prices never support a winner, gap or best-profit claim. VAT, sales tax and customer-paid import charges are excluded or marked unknown. Supported destinations: US, GB, DE, AU, CA. Not for ordering, store integrations, print-quality rankings or other destinations.

canonicalProductId.description: A product id from search_products or resolve_supplier_link, such as `cotton-ringer-tee`.

choices.description: Choices by field, such as { "size": "m", "color": "black" }. Values match a value key, its last part or its label, case-insensitively; get_product_options lists them.

currency.description: Currency for every price, such as USD, GBP or EUR.

destination.description: The buyer's country, where the order ships. Product cost, shipping and duty depend on it.

pricingTier.description: base is each supplier's standard price; tier1 and tier2 are its paid plans.

salesChannel.description: The platform the seller sells on. Needed with sellingPrice or targetMargin for platform fees.

sellingPrice.description: What the seller's customer pays for one selected configuration or pack, in the chosen currency, including any shipping the seller charges. Only when the seller said so.

shopLocation.description: The country the seller's shop is based in, which can differ from the destination the order ships to. Needed with sellingPrice or targetMargin for platform fees.

supplier.description: Show only this supplier, with every product and print provider it offers for the choice.

targetMargin.description: The share of the sale, in percent, the seller wants to keep after supplier cost and platform fees. Returns the price to charge with each supplier. Use instead of sellingPrice.

yourSupplier.description: The supplier the seller uses today. Only when the seller said so; never guess.

price.description: Product cost in the response currency, before shipping; null when unknown, never 0.

priceBasis.description: What the delivered total covers: product and shipping.

pricingBasis.description: The selected price basis and any setup disclosure, in words.

pricingContext.description: Present when this price only holds under stated conditions, such as a design the seller already has.

basis.description: What the price assumes: an existing design the seller already has, or included digitisation.

newDesignSetup.description: How a new design's setup is charged, or that it is included.

applicability.description: design-dependent when the fee depends on the artwork, selected when one fee applies to this order.

application.description: Always not-modelled: the charge is disclosed but never added to a total.

fees.description: The setup fees the supplier lists.

amount.description: The fee amount in its own currency.

conditions.description: What must hold for this fee to apply.

currency.description: Original supplier currency; never converted along with the unit price.

kind.description: What the fee is for: standard, text-only, image, adjustment, back-or-side or setup.

scope.description: What the fee applies to: per design, per design and area, per order, per unit or unknown.

source.description: What the supplier states about this fee.

taxBasis.description: Whether the fee is quoted before VAT (ex-vat) or unclear.

includedInDeliveredTotal.description: Always false: setup charges stay outside the delivered total.

status.description: The supplier lists a setup charge.

conditions.description: What must hold for the inclusion.

source.description: What the supplier states about the inclusion.

status.description: Digitisation is included, so there is no setup charge.

reason.description: Why the setup charge is unknown.

source.description: What the supplier states, when it says anything.

status.description: Whether a setup charge applies could not be established.

physicalSelections.description: The supplier options this price was quoted for.

axisId.description: The option field's id, such as size.

axisLabel.description: The option field as shown, such as Size.

kind.description: sku-option changes the unit price; standard-configuration is a fixed default.

valueLabel.description: The chosen value as shown, such as Adult M.

policyId.description: Which pricing policy this context follows.

policyVersion.description: The version of that pricing policy.

recurringConditions.description: What must remain true for this recurring unit price.

source.description: What the supplier states about this price, in its own words.

pricingPlan.description: The supplier plan this price uses, such as Standard pricing.

pricingPlanId.description: The stable id of that plan, such as `printify:premium`; pass it back instead of guessing from its name. Null when no price is known.

product.description: The supplier's own name for the product.

productUrl.description: The supplier's page for this product and configuration.

dutyStatus.description: How well the supplier-billed duty is established: known, estimated from bounded quotes, or unknown.

estimatedDutyDeducted.description: The estimated duty deducted from the sale; null when duty is known or was not deducted.

feeBreakdown.description: Each platform fee and its amount.

amount.description: The fee amount in the response currency.

label.description: The fee's name, such as transaction fee.

fees.description: Platform fees for this sale in the response currency.

keep.description: What the seller keeps per sale before tax, in the response currency.

margin.description: Share of the sale the seller keeps, 0 to 1; null when the sale is zero.

qualification.description: In words, whether supplier-billed duty is included in or left out of this profit.

sale.description: The selling price in the response currency; with targetMargin, the price to charge.

status.description: Profit could be worked out for this offer.

supplierCost.description: What the supplier charges in the response currency: product, shipping and any known duty.

reason.description: Why: the supplier cost is unknown, the platform fees are unavailable, or the target margin cannot be reached.

status.description: Profit could not be worked out for this offer.

profit.description: This offer's profit when a selling price or target margin was given; null otherwise.

provider.description: The print provider that makes the order, for a marketplace; null for a direct supplier.

shipping.description: Shipping cost in the response currency; null when unknown, never 0.

sourceCurrency.description: The currency the supplier quoted its price in, before conversion to the response currency; null when no quote exists.

taxNote.description: How VAT or sales tax applies to this price, in words.

versusYours.description: Per sale against the seller's own supplier: positive means the seller keeps more here. Uses profit when shown, otherwise the delivered total; null when the two cannot be compared.

sellsProduct.description: False when the supplier does not sell this product in this configuration.

yourSupplier.description: The supplier the seller said they use; null when they did not say.

error.description: The error this call returned instead of a result.

code.description: The machine-readable reason the call failed.

message.description: What went wrong, in words, and what to do next.

title: Compare print-on-demand suppliers
